From the show?}} The '''female servers''' are two characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== The female servers serve drinks at the wrap party for a promotional shoot for the [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] vaults at [[Cooper Howard]]'s house. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== One server asks [[Sebastian Leslie]] to do his Bartholemew Codsworth Butler voice, which he's known for doing from the TV show he once performed on. Sebastion agrees to do it since they meet half of the criteria of who he does it for. After Sebastian does, the voice, the two server ladies giggle with glee, but one flatly rejects his offer when he tried to court them into the hot tub when their shift is over. ==Personality== She's shown to be a fan of Sebastian Leslie for his role as Bartholemew Codsworth on some TV show, but was dismissive toward him when he asked to join him in the hot tub when their shift was over. ==Appearances== The female servers appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|6=106}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
